text: What is the purpose of making adjustments in the final accounts?
options: To record all the transactions
To match the expenses with the revenues
To calculate the profit
To prepare the balance sheet
correctAnswer: To match the expenses with the revenues
explanation: According to the NCERT textbook, adjustments are made in the final accounts to match the expenses with the revenues. This is based on the matching principle of accounting, which states that the expenses should be matched with the revenues of the same period.
subject: Accountancy

text: What is the effect of closing stock on the financial statements?
options: It increases the cost of goods sold
It decreases the cost of goods sold
It has no effect on the cost of goods sold
It increases the revenue
correctAnswer: It decreases the cost of goods sold
explanation: As per the NCERT textbook, the closing stock is valued at the end of the accounting period and is deducted from the cost of goods sold. This decreases the cost of goods sold and increases the profit.
subject: Accountancy

text: How are outstanding expenses treated in the final accounts?
options: They are added to the expenses

They are ignored
They are added to the assets
correctAnswer: They are added to the expenses
explanation: According to the NCERT textbook, outstanding expenses are the expenses that have been incurred but not paid. They are added to the expenses in the profit and loss account to match the expenses with the revenues.

text: What is the purpose of providing for doubtful debts?
